sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a global money transfer platform supporting 80+ currencies and international business payments. This integration provides access to profiles, transfers, and multi-currency balances via OAuth2.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: You need a Wise account (personal or business). Register your application at sandbox.transferwise.tech/register to obtain OAuth2 credentials.

sections.title: How to Connect
sections.content:
1. Sign in to the Wise Developer Portal.
2. Create a new application and set the redirect URI to your OAuth callback URL.
3. Note your Client ID and Client Secret.
4. Request the required scopes (transfers:read, balances:read, profiles:read).
5. Click Connect and authorize with your Wise credentials.

sections.title: Available Actions
sections.content:
list-profiles: List personal and business profiles for the authenticated user.
list-transfers: List international money transfers for a specific profile.
list-accounts: List multi-currency balances for a profile.
